subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt readable path-based session and dashboard URLs as a supported public Control UI bookmark contract, with released query links migrated only at application startup?
rationale: The implementation makes URL shape, bookmark persistence, dashboard selection, and external ClickClack links part of the public product contract; the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human acceptance of that direction after proof.

options.title: Adopt after live proof
options.body: Accept the path-based URL contract once a redacted browser run demonstrates the documented legacy migration and real navigation flows.

options.title: Keep query links
options.body: Decline the new stable URL contract and retain query-form session identity if long-lived deep links should not become a supported surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the path-based URL contract once a redacted browser run demonstrates the documented legacy migration and real navigation flows.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the active implementation and its documented URL-contract rationale on the branch.
